220090101.text: These Treasure Hoarders are running more and more rampant...

220090103.text: Ah, yes. I have a matter to entrust to you. This Bao'er you mentioned previously... After thorough investigation, I have ascertained that she is a Treasure Hoarder.

220090104.text: As for the reason why she acted alone... Perhaps she wanted to take all the treasure for herself, or perhaps she was always meant to be a vanguard for the main group of Treasure Hoarders.

220090105.text: Judging by how she was able to fool even such an experienced adventurer as yourself, she seems adept at subterfuge as well.

220090106.text: If we leave her be, then we also leave the surrounding Treasure Hoarders to run amok. This will put the cultural relics nearby at risk.

220090107.text: Therefore, I'd like you to stop them. Even if we cannot rein them in entirely, rescuing some relics from their clutches will serve.

220090109.text: I'll leave it to you, then.

220090111.text: If I'm not mistaken, this group of Treasure Hoarders has been following me.

220090112.text: These greedy scoundrels haven't simply been content to have me lead them to some treasure.

220090113.text: As long as it's someplace I've been, they will start digging into the ground, thinking to uncover a little something.

220090114.text: I know where they'll show up, it just takes a bit of thought. But I'm just a scholar. Such matters of logic are simple for me...

220090115.text: But combat is something that I'll have to leave to experienced adventurers like you.

220090116.text: So please, take those relics back from the Treasure Hoarders!

220090118.text: Please wait a moment. While I did say you should stop them, I don't mean for you to have a showdown with Bao'er right away.

220090119.text: The Treasure Hoarders have a very loose organization, and it's hard to get ahold of their trail. Now that you've gotten tangled up with them, we have the chance of a lifetime.

220090120.text: I believe that there's a bigger scheme behind their presence here in the Guili Plains. If you stay near Bao'er, you might be able to uncover those plans.

220090121.text: So don't reveal yourself just yet. I trust in your ability to find a hidden point to strike, and to... well, end things quickly.

220090122.text: Remember, get the relics and get out.

220090303.text: Hmm. It's as I thought. They've been tailing me, and digging all along the path my studies have taken me down.

220090304.text: Though they have no technique to speak of, they do have the advantage of numbers, and with those numbers, they've been able to dig up a few things eventually.

220090305.text: Thank you so much. If not for you, who knows what might have happened to those cultural relics?
